source_evidence: Before opening an investment advisory account, you should understand what is covered by your agreement with the investment adviser.
answer: Before opening an investment advisory account, prepare to discuss your goals, timeline, amount to invest, comfort with risk, and the level of service you want. Check the adviser’s background and disciplinary history. Read the advisory contract and disclosure documents so you understand the services, fees, your responsibilities, conflicts of interest, and how to cancel the contract. Ask what fees apply, including fees paid to the adviser and fees charged by third parties, and make sure you understand how those costs are calculated.
